edges.label: AAWSAP deliverable, Acquisition Support Division (DWO-3)
edges.note: The released document names the programme itself. Its inside cover reads 'This product is one in a series of advanced technology reports produced in FY 2009 under the Defense Intelligence Agency ... Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications (AAWSA) Program' - the redaction between them is (b)(3):10 USC 424. Verified by downloading this DIRD and scanning its full text on 23 August 2026. The scans are OCR-degraded, so the quotation is normalised from the damaged rendering.

edges.label: published by DIA as DIA-08-1004-004, Acquisition Threat Support series
edges.note: DIA commissioned, holds and released this document. It carries a DIA document number in the DIA-08-xxxx-xxx series on its cover and was released through the DIA FOIA Electronic Reading Room, whose FileId entry is cited here alongside the retrievable copy. Cover page read on 22 August 2026.

b.label: Traversable Wormholes, Stargates, and Negative Energy

edges.label: author of record on the DIA list and on EarthTech's own citation list
edges.note: DIA list item 8: "Traversable Wormholes, Stargates and Negative Energy, Dr Eric Davis, EarthTech International." Unlike the warp-drive paper, the popular attribution to Davis is confirmed by the government list here. EarthTech's own bibliography carries the same citation with the document number DIA-08-1004-004.

b.label: Traversable Wormholes, Stargates, and Negative Energy

edges.label: series member
edges.note: Membership of the DIRD series is established by the released document itself: its cover page carries the Defense Intelligence Reference Document mark and the DIA Defense Futures banner. Publication date 6 April 2010 on the cover. 43 pages in the released copy. The cover of the scanned release is degraded, so a document number or date is asserted here only where it reads unambiguously.

a.label: Traversable Wormholes, Stargates, and Negative Energy

b.label: EarthTech International / Institute for Advanced Studies at Austin

edges.label: author's affiliation of record; DIRD carried on EarthTech's own publications list
edges.note: EarthTech International lists six DIRDs by Eric Davis on its publications page, with DIA document numbers and the issuing division named as the Acquisition Support Division (DWO-3) or Technology Warning Division (DWO-4) of the Defense Warning Office. A contractor publishing its DIA reference-document numbers on an open website is itself part of how the DIRD series became documentable.
